title: Low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid prepared through photoelectric-Fenton reaction protects Caco-2 cells from oxidative damage by regulating metabolites
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1816-1829
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00387C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiayi Yan, Youxian Zhou, Chen Song, Yunning Yang, Fanhua Kong, Jingfeng Yang, Shuang Song
A novel photoelectric-Fenton method was developed to efficiently depolymerize hyaluronic acid (HA), and the resulting low-molecular-weight HA could protect Caco-2 cells from oxidative damage by regulating cellular metabolites.
